children: Oil rises on the prospect for prolonged supply disruptions in the Middle East. The U.S. and Iran have escalated attacks on each other, ANZ Research analysts say in a research report. They note a U.S. attack targeting Iran, which hit missile launchers on an island in the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway through which one-fifth of the world's oil is transported. Shortly thereafter, missiles were fired at Jordan, where the U.S. has military assets. "Officials from both sides are now preparing for the conflict to drag on for months as talks are deadlocked," the analysts add. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 0.7% higher at $86.35 per barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
